user.title: House Structure

data_description.rotation: Degrees the house is turned clockwise from true north: the value measured from OpenStreetMap is filled in. Its four faces then look this far past north, east, south and west.
data_description.preview: Tick and press Submit to redraw the map with the rotation typed above. Nothing is saved until you submit with this unticked.
data_description.shade_below: Treat the south-east to south-west sun as blocked by trees and neighbours below this elevation. A wall or roof can set its own.
data_description.unit: Sizes are typed in this unit and kept in metres, so changing it later keeps them. In feet and inches, type lengths like 12' 6" (or 12 6); floor areas and volumes are in square and cubic feet.
data_description.sky_source: Where the sun and sky light comes from. Open-Meteo is fetched over the internet every 15 minutes (no key needed). A solar radiation sensor, such as a weather station's, is read every 5 minutes and split into the sun's beam and the rest of the sky.
data_description.sky_sensor: Only for the sensor source: a sensor reading all the sun and sky light on a flat surface, in W/m².

user.title: Window
user.description: A window in a wall or roof; it takes the way it faces from there, and its room too (a skylight in a roof over several rooms can choose one of them). Glass size in {unit}.

data.name: Name
data.host: Wall or roof it is in
data.area_id: Room (only for a roof over several rooms)
data.transmittance: Share of light let in as heat
data.blind_closed: Share let in with the blind closed

data_description.name: Leave empty for a name from the room.
data_description.area_id: For a skylight in a roof over several rooms: the room it lights. Leave empty to use the roof's first room, or the wall's room.
data_description.transmittance: About 0.7 for double glazing, 0.5 for low-e.
data_description.blind: A cover entity; its position (0 to 100) says how open it is.
data_description.blind_closed: How much of the sun still gets in with the blind shut.
